article.title: Expansion of ‘Yellow Line’ forcing Palestinians out of their homes
article.author: Editor
article.content: Israeli occupation's Yellow Line expansion is forcing Palestinian families to relocate and restricting access to homes, farmland, and essential services, the Gaza Rights Center warns. The post Expansion of ‘Yellow Line’ forcing Palestinians out of their homes appeared first on MR Online .
